title: Tenant note CRUD
description: Create, edit, and delete tenant notes (COMPLAINT/DAMAGE/GENERAL) with an occurredOn date independent of createdAt/updatedAt, plus an optional photo.
acceptanceCriteria: Note occurredOn can be set in the past
Editing and deleting an existing note both work
Deleting is a hard delete (no undo required)
